video.title: AI欧腐《冒名顶替的深海执念/Caught Between My Master and His Imposter》
video.desc:
这剧本可以啊 nc也有 整体很棒了
Cole, a battle-hardened veteran, becomes personal bodyguard to Julian, heir of an old-money family. After a kidnapping, Julian returns — but he's no longer human. He's Elio, a deep-sea creature wearing Julian's skin, carrying fragments of Julian's memories and obsessing over Cole. Cole can't expose the truth or walk away. Trapped between fear, desire, duty, and love, he finds himself sinking deeper into the monster's world.
身经百战的退役军人 Cole，成为了豪门继承人 Julian 的私人保镖。一场绑架过后，Julian 回来了——但他已不再是人类。他是 Elio，一只披着 Julian 皮囊的深海生物，身上残留着 Julian 的部分记忆，并对 Cole 产生了近乎执念的痴迷。Cole 既无法揭穿真相，也无法转身离开。在恐惧、欲望、职责与爱意的夹缝中越陷越深，一步步沉入这个"怪物"编织的世界。
